protocol.name: pixi_shell_v1

description.summary: private protocol between the Pixi compositor and its shell

protocol.description:
The Pixi session is two programs: the compositor (pixi) and the shell (pixi-shell) it starts. This interface is how the shell learns which application windows exist and tells the compositor what to show.
It is privileged. The compositor advertises the global only to the shell process it started itself, identified by the pid the kernel reports for the connection, never by anything the client says about itself.

interface.name: pixi_shell_v1

description.summary: control of the session's windows

interface.description: The shell's own window is an ordinary xdg_toplevel. The compositor keeps it the size of the display and decides, from the mode below, whether it is drawn in front of the applications, over them, or not at all.

entry.name: home
entry.summary: only the shell is shown; applications are hidden

entry.name: overlay
entry.summary: the shell is drawn over the front application and has keyboard focus

entry.name: app
entry.summary: the front application is shown and focused; the shell is hidden

request.name: set_mode

description.summary: choose what the display shows

request.description: Asking for app mode while no application window exists is answered with home mode. The compositor always confirms with a mode event.

description.summary: bring one application window to the front and show it
politely ask one application window to close
end the process behind one application window

request.name: preview

description.summary: show a live, scaled picture of an application window

request.description: Draws the window's current contents into the given rectangle, in display coordinates, on top of the shell. The shell uses this for the app switcher. Sending it again for the same window moves or resizes the picture. Pictures not sent again before the next previews_flush are removed. Windows that aren't shown or have gone away are ignored.

description.summary: remove previews that weren't refreshed since the last flush
end the session

event.name: window

description.summary: an application window appeared or changed

event.description: Sent when a window is first shown and again whenever its title or application id changes. The id is stable for the window's lifetime and never reused within a session.

description.summary: an application window went away

event.name: front

description.summary: which application window is in front

event.description: Zero when there is no application window at all.

description.summary: the mode now in force

event.name: guide

description.summary: the compositor's guide key binding was pressed

event.description: The Super key, Home or F1 on a keyboard. Controllers are read by the shell itself, which asks for overlay mode when their guide button is pressed.

request.name: key

description.summary: type a key into the front application

request.description: Sends a key press or release to the front application window, as if it came from a keyboard, for the shell's on-screen keyboard. Ignored unless an application is in front in app mode. The keycode is an evdev code (KEY_A is 30). modifiers holds the xkb modifier bits held down: 1 Shift, 4 Control, 8 Alt.

request.name: pointer_move

description.summary: move the pointer

request.description: Moves the pointer by a distance in display pixels, as if a mouse had, for the shell's gamepad-as-mouse mode. The pointer is drawn and sent to whichever window is under it. Ignored unless an application is in front in app mode.

request.name: pointer_button

description.summary: press or release a pointer button

request.description: Sends a button press or release to the window under the pointer. The button is an evdev code (BTN_LEFT is 272, BTN_RIGHT 273, BTN_MIDDLE 274). Ignored unless an application is in front in app mode.

request.name: pointer_scroll

description.summary: scroll the window under the pointer

request.description: Scrolls by an amount in wheel notches, positive being down and to the right. Ignored unless an application is in front in app mode.

request.name: pointer_visible

description.summary: show or hide the pointer image

request.description: The pointer is shown the first time it moves. The shell hides it again when it leaves gamepad-as-mouse mode.

request.name: screenshot

description.summary: save the picture of an application's window

request.description: Writes the window's current picture to a file as a binary PPM (P6), for the shell's screenshot button, which turns it into a PNG. The file appears all at once, under its final name, when it is complete; if the picture can't be read, nothing is written. The path must be absolute. Ignored for the shell's own window.
